welcome.salutation: Hello, and welcome to the Turnip Prophet app on your Nook Phone.
welcome.description: This app lets you track your island's turnip prices daily, but you'll have to put the prices in yourself!
welcome.conclusion: After that, the Turnip Prophet app will magically predict the turnip prices you'll have for the rest of the week.

first-time.title: First-Time Buyer
first-time.description: Choose Yes for your island's first-ever week buying turnips from Daisy Mae. If any resident bought from her on your island in an earlier week, choose No.

patterns.title: Previous Pattern
patterns.description: What was last week's turnip price pattern?(This affects your pattern)

prices.description: What was the price of turnips this week on your island?
prices.reset-warning:
Are you sure you want to reset all fields?

This cannot be undone!

profit.title: Profit & investment
profit.description: Choose an entered selling price to see what you would earn if you sold all your turnips at that price.
profit.invalid-quantity: Enter a positive whole number of turnips within the supported range.
profit.empty: Enter your turnip quantity to calculate investment and profit.
profit.missing-buy: Enter a positive whole-number purchase price above to calculate your investment.
profit.missing-sell: Enter a positive whole-number selling price above to see a hypothetical sale.
profit.scenario: Hypothetical results for selling all turnips at the selected price.
profit.too-large: These values are too large to calculate accurately. Use smaller values.

output.title: Output
output.likely-pattern: Based on your prices so far, you're most likely on a {{0}} pattern ({{1}} chance).
output.sell-advice: The expected maximum price for selling later is {{0}} bells on {{1}}.
output.buy-advice: The expected maximum sell price for the week is {{0}} bells.

textbox.description: After you've listed some turnip prices, the Turnip Prophet will run some numbers and display the different possible patterns that your island may experience.
textbox.development: This app is still in development, but will improve over time!
textbox.thanks: None of this would have been possible without Ninji's work figuring out just how Timmy and Tommy value their turnips.
textbox.support: Support, comments and contributions are available through GitHub
textbox.sponsor: Want to sponsor the developers behind this project? Go to the GitHub page and click '❤ Sponsor'
textbox.contributors-text: Oh! And let's not forget to thank those who have contributed so far!

errors.impossible-values: No turnip price pattern matches these inputs.
errors.first-time-buyer: If any resident bought turnips from Daisy Mae on your island in an earlier week, set First-Time Buyer to No.
errors.check-prices: Use Daisy Mae's Sunday price from your own island, or leave it blank if you're unsure. Check each AM or PM slot and use prices from the same island and week.
errors.time-travel: If moving the in-game clock backward reset your prices, use entries from after the reset.
errors.github: Still seeing this message? Include your permalink when you report the problem.
